text:
alex: Heads-up — hit a gap in billing for a customer using spot fallback yesterday. Usage events made it to accounting but the applied price wasn't recorded, so invoice mismatch.
jin: ugh. do we know which field was dropped?
alex: looks like when the runtime switched instance type the client-side rate_card tag wasn't available. events had token counts but no pricing_metadata.rate_card_id. example: `{"tenant_id":"t-123","tokens":432,"timestamp":...}` — no price context.
robin: is this a producer-side tagging problem or an ingest enrichment miss?
maria: quick check — our ingest enrichment only adds pricing when we can resolve region+instance from headers. if producer was on private deploy it might not emit headers, so enrich step skipped.
alex: right. two failure modes: producer never tags, or enricher can't resolve. both cause invoice gaps.
jin: options: 1) require producers to emit rate_card_id (strict), 2) enrich at ingest with a fallback table (best-effort), 3) record applied_rate in the final billing step and write back an attribution audit entry. tradeoffs?
robin: (1) is simple but breaks older SDKs and private customers. not feasible short-term.
maria: (2) cheaper for ops but increases ingest complexity and coupling to infra metadata; needs TTL for fallback table and rollback plan for drift.
jin: (3) centralizes truth in billing but hurts upstream observability — teams lose correlation between request and price at event time. also harder to stitch in realtime dashboards.
alex: we should aim for hybrid: producers emit optional `pricing_metadata.rate_card_id` when available, ingest enrichment does best-effort resolution, and billing writes an `applied_pricing` audit event that includes provenance for later replay. that preserves observability and guarantees final invoice correctness.
robin: agreed. schema change required: add optional `pricing_metadata` object to usage event. need to version it `v1` and have ingest ignore unknown fields for forward compat.
maria: addendum: enrichment should not overwrite producer-provided rate_card_id. priority order: producer tag > enrichment resolution > billing fallback.
jin: what about event size and downstream storage cost? adding `pricing_metadata` (a tiny id + maybe label) is minimal, but `applied_pricing` audit rows will be added. budget estimate?
alex: rough calc: ~0.5 bytes per event for id + audit writes ~1.2M extra rows/month at scale X -> ~0.03% storage bump. acceptable.
robin: backfill plan? some customers already invoiced incorrectly. we should run a reconciliation to generate apply events for historical windows where token usage present but pricing missing.
maria: reconcile job: query raw usage for last 30d where `pricing_metadata` null, attempt best-effort enrichment, emit `applied_pricing` audit with `reconciled:true`. flag any high-delta tenants for manual review.
jin: security/privacy note — rate_card_id is non-sensitive. but the applied rate (currency/amount) might be considered billing data; ensure audits respect access controls and retention policy.
alex: good catch. audits go to billing-audit store with current ACLs and 1y retention.
robin: timeline and owners? I'll pick up schema PR for `pricing_metadata` and validation tests. jin you own ingest enrichment changes. maria you own reconcile job and reconciliation dashboard. alex will coordinate billing side write & audit contract.
alex: assigned. can we target a staged rollout: schema + SDK notice -> ingest change in canary region -> billing write enable -> global flip?
jin: yes. recommend feature flag for applied_pricing emission so we can disable if we find regressions.
maria: I'll add a dashboard to show delta between raw tokens * canonical rate vs invoiced amount during canary.
robin: new docs needed: producer SDK guide (how to send optional rate_card_id), ingest contract doc, and billing audit schema.
alex: follow-ups: @jin create PR for enricher + flag, @robin create schema PR, @maria proto reconcile job and dashboard. ping in #eng-platform when PRs are ready.
metering-bot: deploybot: canary deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T02:00Z (mock) :rocket:
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all, will post summary in #billing-weekly and link threads.
robin: FYI — edge-case: cross-tenant pooling where a single billing account uses multiple rate cards. we should add `rate_card_source` enum (producer|enricher|billing_reconcile).
jin: ack, will include `rate_card_source`.
maria: noted. putting milestone: "ratecard-tagging-v1" due 2026-04-10.
alex: closing notes: prefer enrichment read-only and non-blocking on ingest path. any failure to resolve should still emit usage with null pricing and be reconciled later.
robin: sounds good. done for now.
